articles.title: Walmart’s Flipkart is quietly building a food delivery challenger in India
articles.summary: Flipkart has expanded access to its food-delivery service to thousands of employees ahead of its public launch.

articles.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
articles.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

articles.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
articles.summary: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

articles.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
articles.summary: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

articles.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
articles.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

articles.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
articles.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

articles.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
articles.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

articles.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
articles.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

articles.title: LatAm Startup Funding Jumps 26% In Q3 As VCs Begin ‘Rediscovering’ The Region
articles.summary: A continued boom in late-stage and growth funding combined with a surge in seed-stage funding helped buoy venture investment in Latin America for the third quarter of 2026, Crunchbase data shows.

articles.summary: Enterprise AI companies relying on armies of forward deployed engineers are disguising labor-intensive services as scalable software, inflating recurring revenue and valuations while falling short of autonomy claims, argues Anurag Gurtu, co-founder and CEO of Airrived. articles.summary: Prosecutors say Abdulrahman Alfozan searched OpenAI tools for meetings with Saudi officials, and the Saudi government offered to back his bond.

articles.title: The AI productivity boom has bosses asking what’s in it for employees
articles.summary: Leaders at PepsiCo, Indeed, Dropbox, and Bristol Myers Squibb are rethinking who benefits from AI’s productivity gains.

articles.summary: One unnamed hospitality group placed a $60,000 trade on Kalshi to offset missed revenue from the Dodgers’ failure to advance to the World Series, according to the platform.

articles.title: Gen Z is chasing the American Dream in South Carolina, Missouri, and Tennessee—as California loses thousands of young adults and billionaires
articles.summary: As billionaires like Larry Page and Peter Thiel leave California, Gen Z is following suit—they’re moving to more affordable South Carolina and Missouri.

articles.title: France is rioting over surging inflation, skyrocketing national debt, and crumbling schools. America is its sleeping twin
articles.summary: Growth is the main thing keeping the U.S. from looking like France. Underneath it, the debt math and the classrooms look a lot alike.

articles.title: Ukraine’s drones lose their Starlink link above 100 mph. Musk, Rubio, and Trump all say it wasn’t them
articles.summary: Kyiv says a sudden SpaceX speed limit is knocking out interceptor drones it needs against Russia’s jet-powered Shaheds. Musk, the White House, and Trump all say it wasn’t them.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley’s favorite AI stock is 92% exposed to the $1.6 trillion build-out it’s bullish on
articles.summary: The bank calls Nvidia the best risk/reward in AI. Its own report lays out what happens to suppliers when a capital cycle turns.
